body: I had the same issues using the latest `[gem install algoliasearch-rails](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-rails#install)` guide and `[yarn add vue-instantsearch](https://github.com/algolia/vue-instantsearch)`. I had to `[yarn add vue-server-renderer](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vue-server-renderer)` to get past the error warnings.
